static_profile.business_description: Atlas Copco AB — Swedish industrial group, global market leader in compressors, vacuum solutions, and industrial air/gas equipment, plus power tools and assembly systems (via the Industrial Technique division). Large recurring aftermarket/service revenue tail alongside equipment sales. Not sourced from a fetched figure - general public-record description, kept for context only, no numeric claims embedded.
static_profile.competitive_moat_notes: Global #1/#2 positions in compressor and vacuum-solutions categories, high-margin recurring service/aftermarket revenue, decades-long track record. Durable observation, not tied to a specific fetch date.

insider_activity_cache.notes: 10 transactions returned, searched as 'Atlas Copco', filtered to exact issuer match (Atlas Copco Aktiebolag / Atlas Copco AB). Mostly option-exercise pairs by senior executives Henrik Elmin and Sara Hagg Liljedal (cashless exercise+immediate disposal, routine/scheduled, low signal per skill weighting). One genuine open-market Acquisition: board member Kenneth Lagerborg bought 7,000 B-shares at 161.57 SEK on 2026-06-09 (~1.13M SEK), price below the current 182.5 SEK - a real but single-insider, ~2-month-old buy signal. No recent insider selling cluster.
